title: What denklik is, and why it takes so long
excerpt: Denklik is the Turkish recognition of a foreign secondary qualification, and it delays more applications than any other single step. This explains what it is, what it needs, and why it is worth starting early.

children.text: Denklik is the process by which Türkiye recognises a secondary school qualification issued in another country. Without it, an acceptance letter cannot become an enrolment.

The reason it delays applications is structural rather than bureaucratic obstruction. The certificate has to be authenticated in the issuing country first, which is a separate process with its own queue, and only then can it be submitted in Türkiye.
